title: Egyptian symbols in a Freemasonic temple in DC
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Egyptian symbols in a Freemasonic temple in DC, about unspecified at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've been inside of this like Freemasonic temple in DC

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says he has been inside a temple of the Freemasons, an old society that meets in private lodges, in Washington DC. He describes it as full of Egyptian symbols, and he brings it up as a hint that ancient ideas still run quietly through the places where power sits.
